statement: The client has a conservative profile with a 5-year investment horizon, a preservation objective, low risk tolerance, and a low capacity to bear losses. The proposed portfolio consists of Xtrackers II EUR Overnight Rate Swap UCITS ETF 1C (SRI 1) weighted at 70% and iShares € Govt Bond 1-3yr UCITS ETF EUR Dist (SRI 2) weighted at 30%. This portfolio is suitable for the client as its risk level aligns with the client's predicted risk class of 1. The weighted SRI of the portfolio is 1.3, which respects the maximum allowed fund and average SRI limits for this risk profile. Furthermore, the client does not have any near-term liquidity needs within the next two years. Draft for advisor review and signature.
